name: grid-btc-q2-2026
_comment: Pipeline demo, not a strategy proposal. The grid bounds are the high and low of
2026-01..2026-02, i.e. the two months BEFORE the tested window — picking them from
the tested window itself would fit the parameters to the answer and any 'PASSED'
verdict would be manufactured. See docs/strategy-search.md, 'Главный риск проекта'.
Every key here is optional except symbol, from, to, bot.kind and costs.
